title: Germany – Financial and insurance services – 10045510-Consultancy support services for the development and implementation of sustainable finance taxonomies
description: The objective of GIZ's global project Sustainable Economic Transformation and Sustainable Finance is to advance the transformation towards a more sustainable economy and financial sector, grounded in international standards and global agendas. To this end, the project implements activities in three main areas of intervention: - Pillar 1: Fostering global knowledge exchange and peer-learning regarding the sustainable transformation of the economy and the financial sector. - Pillar 2: Supporting development of policy and regulatory frameworks in partner countries governing the transformation toward a sustainable economy and financial sector in partner countries. - Pillar 3: Providing advisory services and technical assistance to embed sustainability in governance and financial decision-making of financial institutions. In pillar 2, the project supports partner countries in aligning their financial regulatory and policy frameworks with international standards and best practices on sustainable finance. This encompasses, for example, the development of taxonomies, disclosure regulations, sustainable financial product standards or policies on ESG risk management. The project's activities include, for example, supporting the development of national taxonomies in Rwanda, Peru, Senegal, Ghana, The Philippines, and Mexico. The support provided by GIZ is comprehensive, including strategic advice, capacity building, design of multi-stakeholder processes (e.g., coordination of technical expert groups, support for public consultation), drafting advice (e.g., on the selection of sectors and screening criteria), and supporting the taxonomy's dissemination and implementation. This process is complemented by peer-learning opportunities and featuring lessons learned from implementation in partner countries in relevant international and regional forums. The objective of this tender is to establish a flexible pool of specialized technical expertise that can support sustainable finance taxonomy initiatives in partner countries designated by GIZ during the contract period. The contractor will provide advisory services covering the development, enhancement and implementation of sustainable finance taxonomies, as well as related analytical work, capacity building and knowledge products.
buyer: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH

title: SV-CMÜ-240819-001 - ETF-A_Neubau einer Werkstatt, Raumlufttechnische Anlagen, Gewerk Lüftung
description: Im Gebäudeteil Kopfbau wird im Untergeschoß eine zentrale Lüftungsaufbereitung errichtet und dient zur gesamten Versorgung der Büro- und Laborflächen. Dazu wird über eine Frischluftansaugung über Dach die Luft in das Untergeschoß angesagt, dort thermisch vorbehandelt und anschließend über ein weit verzweigtes Verteilungsnetz im gesamten Gebäude anforderungsspezifisch verteilt. Zusätzlich sind in dem Gebäude zwei Abluftsystem zu installieren, welche die Abluft von Laboranlagen über Dach ins Freie bringen. Die Werkhalle verfügt über zwei getrennte Lüftungseinheiten, die zum Einen, den Bürobereich im EG und 1.OG versorgen und zum Anderen die große Halle belüften und thermisch behandeln. Die Geräte selbst befinden sich in der westlichen Technikzentrale im 2.OG der Werkhalle. Alle drei Lüftungseinheiten sind, für eine effiziente und energetisch wirkungsvolle Auslastung, mit Kreuzstromwärmetauschern ausgestattet, die einen hygienisch einwandfreien Betrieb erlauben. Der Gebäudeteil Satellit entsteht etwas zeitversetzt, hier sind keine speziellen Anforderungen an die Raumluft gestellt. Der Waschplatz wird zur Belüftung und Abtrocknung mit einem Axialventilator temporär belüftet. Die Arbeiten umfassen stichpunktartig zusammengefasst folgende nicht abschließende Tätigkeiten: Lieferung, Einbringung und Montage von Kanälen, Rohren und Komponenten; Verteilleitung bzw. Kanalnetz in den Fluren, Zwischendecken und Schächten; Errichten von Haupttrassen und Etagenabgängen; Rohmontage der Kanäle; Einbau von Lüftungsgeräten; Einbau von Komponenten wie Volumenstromreglern, Schalldämpfer und Brandschutklappen; Feinmontage und Geräteanschluss, Anschluss der Laboreinrichtung; Einstellung und Inbetriebnahme; Dichtheitsprüfung und Reinigung der Kanäle und Geräte; Gemeinsame Inbetriebnahme der Hauptkomponenten und der Gesamtanlage; Abnahmen und Hygieneinspektion; Erstellen einer Bestandsdokumentation;

title: IN-ORBIT DEMONSTRATION OF A NARROW BAND INTERNET OF THINGS (NB-IOT) INTER-SATELLITE DATA RELAY (ARTES 4.0 SPL 5G/6G 3E.023)
description: The objective of this activity is to proof that a standardised existing solution such as NB-IOT can be used for satellite-to-satellite low data rate communications. Targeted Improvements: Introduce world's first standardised intersatellite data relay solution based on 3GPP NTN standards, opening up a new market for new companies and telecom operators toprovide data solutions to Earth Observation missions via intersatellite data relay. Description: This activity will take as a baseline the various NB-IoT NTN developments in industry and implement a data relay solution (LEO-GEO, LEO-MEO or higher LEO-lower LEO) based on these standards. The intention is to exploit the already existing GEO based NB IoT service providers (e.g., Inmarsat, Skylo, Echostar), that provide services to ground services, and use them to provide a connection to a LEO embarked NB-IoT user terminal. The activity will include an initial assessment of the system architecture and different trade-off between regulatory constraints, frequencies, data relay use cases and variations to the standardised air interfaces shall be made. A prototype of the NB-IoT NTN data relay user terminal modem shall be implemented and embarked on a small satellite, which would use a GEO based relay to interface with the corresponding eNB on ground.Procurement Policy: C(2) = A relevant participation (in terms of quality and quantity) of non-primes (incl. description: Deze marktconsultatie van Rijkswaterstaat Centrale Informatievoorziening (RWS CIV) heeft betrekking op de beoogde aanbesteding van een aantal Light Detection and Ranging-systemen (LiDAR-systemen). Rijkswaterstaat beoogt een aantal LiDAR-systemen te plaatsen op de platformen van windenergiegebieden op de Noordzee om informatie betreffende windrichting en windsnelheden te vergaren. Het groeiend aantal windparken in de Nederlandse Noordzee biedt zowel de noodzaak als de mogelijkheid om de windcondities op die locaties te meten. De gegevens kunnen o.a. worden gebruikt voor nowcasting en het verbeteren van weersvoorspellingen, het verhogen van de efficiëntie van de windturbines, evenals voor wind klimatologische doeleinden. title: LAMPA BACTERICIDA UVC DE 2X30W CU SUPORT MOBIL, STERILIZARE SUPRAFETE
description:
Lampa bactericida UVC de 2x30W cu suport mobil, sterilizare suprafete Lampa bactericida de 2x30W cu suport mobil este utilizata pentru dezinfectia aerului si a suprafetelor din incaperi cu incarcatura microbiana mare prin intermediul radiatiei ultraviolete. Lampa bactericida de 2x30W cu suport mobil foloseste o lungime de unda de 253,7 nm la care efectul germicid este maxim. Lampile cu montare pe stativ mobil contin in pret stativul mobil. Acesta este cromat, telescopic (130-220cm), cu 5 role, dintre care 2 cu frana si sistem de descarcare a electricitatii statice la pamant. Stativul rezista la o inclinare de maxim 10% (5,70) cu o sarcina de maxim 8 kg. Lampa bactericida de 2x30W cu suport mobil se poate folosi cu succes pentru: - unitati sanitare, laboratoare de microbiologie, laboratoare de analize medicale, sali de operatie, sali de asteptare; - industria farmaceutica, productia de medicamente; - industria alimentara, producatori/depozite/transport produse alimentare, industria bauturilor alcoolice si racoritoare, depozite de legume si fructe; - silozuri de nutreturi concentrate, abatoare, ferme pentru cresterea animalelor si pasarilor; - unitati hoteliere, filatelie, arhivistica, depozite de patrimoniu, biblioteci, unitati bancare. Lampa bactericida are un dispozitiv de orientare care asigura rotirea lampii cu aproximativ 240° si posibilitatea orientarii fluxului radiatiei UV in directia dorita. Lampa bactericida cu suport mobil poate fi utilizata si in prezenta

title: Request for information: Hyperspectral imaging cameras
description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION / MARKET CONSULTATION: Hyperspectral Imaging Cameras Tampereen korkeakoulusäätiö sr (hereinafter referred to as the “Contracting Authority”) is planning a procurement of hyperspectral imaging camera equipment (TAU/4632/2026). This notice is a preliminary market consultation and not a call for tenders or a contract notice. The purpose of this market consultation is to identify suppliers and available solutions on the market and to gather information to support the preparation of the upcoming procurement. The information received may be used to refine the technical requirements and structure of the procurement. Hyperspectral imaging cameras capture data across a large number of narrow spectral bands, enabling detailed material identification based on spectral characteristics. Such systems are applicable in a wide range of research, development, and applied use cases where precise material discrimination is required. The preliminary scope of the procurement includes: - Acquisition of one (1) to three (3) hyperspectral imaging cameras. - Primary interest is in cameras covering the visible, short-wave infrared, and mid-wave infrared spectral ranges. In addition, long-wave infrared solutions may also be considered. - Depending on available solutions, either one (1) camera covering a broad wavelength range, or two (2) or three (3) cameras, each covering a narrower spectral range. - Compatible illumination solutions covering the same spectral ranges as the cameras, with known or calibrated spectral characteristics. The requirements described above are indicative and preliminary. The Contracting Authority is particularly interested in obtaining information on: - Available camera technologies and their technical specifications. - Trade-offs between single wide-range systems and multiple narrower-range systems. - Illumination solutions compatible with hyperspectral imaging and their calibration. - Integration aspects, data handling, and potential system configurations. - Indicative pricing, including any required software with a perpetual license. The estimated value of the planned procurement is EUR 100,000–230,000 for the hyperspectral cameras and supporting illumination solutions. These estimates are preliminary and subject to change. This notice aims to initiate a market dialogue with potential suppliers. Participation in the market consultation is voluntary. Responding or not responding to this request does not affect a supplier’s ability to participate in any future procurement procedure. The information presented in this notice is preliminary and may change during the procurement preparation phase. The Contracting Authority may carry out market dialogue in the form of written submissions and, if deemed necessary, supplier-specific discussions (via Microsoft Teams). No compensation will be paid for participation. All information received will be treated confidentially. The indicative timetable for the procurement process is as follows: - Deadline for responses to this Request for Information: 31 July 2026 - Invitation to tender: September 2026 - Decision: November 2026 - Signing the Agreements: December 2026 The upcoming procurement will take place in compliance with the Directive 2014/24/EU on public procurement and the Finnish Act on Public Procurement and Concession Contracts (1397/2016). An open procedure will be applied. The Request for Information documents are available only in English.
